summary: Iter54 — Now Brief TTS voice change to onyx verified end-to-end. Backend TTS pipeline confirmed: ElevenLabs attempted first (returns 401 with current key), transparently falls back to OpenAI onyx. Frontend source has voice: 'onyx' at the single playResponse callsite; zero occurrences of 'alloy' or 'speechSynthesis'/'SpeechSynthesisUtterance' anywhere in /app/frontend/src and /app/frontend/app. Live UI test (kishan/Kishan@Boss2026 quick-login → unmute → refresh) fired a real POST /api/assistant/tts/stream which backend logs show hit the ElevenLabs-fail → OpenAI-onyx fallback path, returning 200 OK; Now Brief card visually rendered 'Speaking… / Bol raha hoon…' confirming audio actually streamed to the client. Also captured an earlier GET wire call with explicit ?voice=onyx query param. All acceptance criteria met, no regressions.
